q: The test-retest method estimates reliability by:
options: giving two different tests to different groups
giving the same test twice to the same group and correlating the scores
checking the paper twice by one teacher
exp: The correlation between two administrations shows stability.

q: What is the correct order in dealing with learning difficulties?
options: Identify the problem, diagnose the cause, apply the remedy
exp: A remedy is useful only after the difficulty and its cause are known.

q: The main purpose of action research in a classroom is to:
options: solve an immediate practical problem and improve practice
exp: Action research is aimed at local, practical improvement.

q: DIKSHA is:
options: a national digital platform for school education e-content
exp: DIKSHA (Digital Infrastructure for Knowledge Sharing) provides e-content, QR-coded textbooks and teacher training.

q: According to NEP 2020, the secondary stage covers the ages of:
exp: The secondary stage consists of Grades 9 to 12.

q: Teachers' Day in India is celebrated on:
exp: It marks the birth anniversary of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.

q: Before writing a program in a class, a teacher should first ask students to:
exp: Planning the logic first improves problem-solving.

q: Learning is best defined as:
options: a change caused only by growth and maturation
a change caused by fatigue or drugs
a relatively permanent change in behaviour brought about by experience or practice
exp: Maturation, fatigue and drugs produce temporary or non-learned changes, so they are excluded from the definition.

q: In a symposium:
options: several speakers present different aspects of a single topic before an audience
students enact characters in a drama
a teacher dictates notes to the class
exp: A symposium is a series of short prepared talks on different aspects of the same theme.

q: An overhead projector (OHP) is classified as a:
exp: OHP projects transparencies on a screen so it is a projected visual aid.

q: In microteaching, a teacher trainee practises:
options: one specific teaching skill at a time
exp: Focusing on a single skill makes feedback and improvement manageable.

q: Which of the following verbs is NOT suitable for writing a specific measurable objective?
exp: 'Appreciate' describes an internal state that cannot be directly observed.

q: An integrated curriculum is one in which:
options: subject boundaries are reduced and related content is combined around themes
each subject is taught fully separately
exp: Integration links knowledge from different subjects.

q: Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation (CCE) was mandated for elementary education under:
exp: Section 29 of the RTE Act, 2009 provides for CCE.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: In an MCQ, the incorrect options are called:
exp: Distractors are plausible wrong options; the correct one is the key.

q: In the split-half method, the test is commonly divided into:
exp: The correlation of half-scores is stepped up by the Spearman-Brown formula.

q: Enrichment programmes are designed mainly for:
exp: Enrichment adds depth and challenge for talented children.

q: Which is the correct cycle of action research?
exp: The cycle repeats with the revised plan after reflection.

q: SWAYAM Prabha is:
options: a group of DTH educational channels that telecast high-quality programmes
exp: It broadcasts educational content 24x7 through DTH channels.

q: NEP 2020 recommends that, wherever possible, the medium of instruction till at least Grade 5 should be:
options: the home language, mother tongue or local language
exp: Children learn most easily in their home language.

q: In the modern view, the teacher's role is best described as:
exp: The teacher guides and supports learners in constructing knowledge.

q: Pair programming in the classroom is an approach where:
options: two students work together at one computer, one coding and the other reviewing
each student works with different tasks silently
exp: It promotes collaboration and fewer errors.

q: Skinner's operant conditioning is mainly concerned with:
exp: Operant conditioning shapes voluntary behaviour by its consequences (reinforcement/punishment).

q: A seminar is best described as:
options: a one-way lecture by an expert
a group meeting where papers are presented and discussed under guidance
a written test with objective questions
a practical session in the laboratory
exp: In a seminar participants present prepared papers followed by interaction.

q: Which of the following is a non-projected visual aid?
exp: Charts, models and maps are shown directly without projection.

q: Using praise such as 'Very good' and a nod for a correct answer is the skill of:
exp: Positive verbal and non-verbal responses strengthen desired behaviour.

q: The 5E instructional model consists of Engage, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate and:
exp: The sequence is Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate.

q: The term 'null curriculum' refers to:
options: what the school does not teach but could have
exp: Eisner used it for content and skills that are left out.

q: In CCE, the word 'comprehensive' means that the evaluation covers:
options: only the subjects in the examination
both scholastic and co-scholastic aspects of the learner's development
exp: Comprehensive evaluation assesses overall development, including attitudes and skills.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: Which of the following is a supply-type (recall) item?
exp: Supply-type items require the student to produce the answer.

q: A test that adequately covers the syllabus content has high:
exp: Content validity is judged by how well the test represents the subject content.

q: Dysgraphia is a learning difficulty related to:
exp: Dysgraphia affects handwriting and written expression.

q: Who generally conducts action research?
options: The practising teacher in his or her own class
exp: Teachers research their own problems.

q: NPTEL provides:
options: video and web courses in engineering and science through IITs and IISc
exp: NPTEL is a joint initiative of the IITs and IISc.

q: NEP 2020 recommends public investment in education of:
exp: The policy reiterates the target of 6% of GDP.

q: Corporal punishment of children in schools is prohibited by:
options: The Indian Penal Code only for adults
exp: Section 17 prohibits physical punishment and mental harassment.

q: Block-based languages like Scratch are useful for beginners because they:
options: are the only way to learn programming
remove syntax errors and focus on logic
are faster than every other language
exp: Drag-and-drop blocks help novices concentrate on concepts.

q: Operant conditioning theory of learning is associated with:
exp: Skinner studied how behaviour is shaped by reinforcement; Pavlov proposed classical conditioning.
